verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents a BYOC deployment option that runs inside the customer's own AWS or Google Cloud account, and claims that in BYOC data never leaves "your cloud or your hardware." However, the product describes itself as "fully managed hosting," and nothing shows customers can download, install, and operate the core engine and storage layer themselves. Missing for 10: a documented self-managed or on-prem installation of the core product, deployment artifacts and instructions, Azure or on-prem BYOC coverage, and independent corroboration.
